title: Lumen Print
description: A sheet of photo paper lying in the sun with a pressed fern and an old brass key on it. Lift them off and their pale, soft-edged prints are left behind in peach on plum. Lay the fern, the grass or the key anywhere and the paper keeps exposing around them; move one mid-exposure for a double ghost, then fix the print before the sun takes it.
intent: A camera-less photograph you make with your hands: the paper is a live exposure field, and every object leaves exactly the shadow it cast.

sources.name: basement.studio shader-lab, Lumen print pass (Apache-2.0)
sources.what: The tone chain from lumen-print-pass.ts and color-map-lut.ts: 16-tap golden-angle diffusion rotated by a per-pixel hash, the bright-pass halation, ragged washout from two value-noise octaves, edge burn wobbled by noise, midtone-weighted grain, and the default plum to peach gradient-map stops. Ported to GLSL over a live exposure field instead of an image.

sources.name: Lumen printing, the process
sources.what: Objects on silver gelatin paper in daylight, no developer; uncovered paper darkens toward plum while shadowed areas stay pale, and fixing shifts the colours warmer.

sources.name: Lenis, damp
sources.what: Frame-rate independent damp for the held objects and their lift.
